title: The Story Behind ‘They’re Eating the Pets’

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在早上4点30分给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中历经七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能几乎每年都是联盟中最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不太喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，即可在 nytimes.com slash subscribe 享受特惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布里娜·塔韦尔尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: At this week's presidential debate.
sentences.zh: 在本周的总统辩论中。

sentences.en: In Springfield, they're eating the dogs, the people that came in.
sentences.zh: 在斯普林菲尔德，他们在吃狗，那些新来的人。

sentences.en: They're eating the cats.
sentences.zh: 他们在吃猫。

sentences.en: They're eating the pets of the people that live there.
sentences.zh: 他们在吃当地居民的宠物。

sentences.en: Donald Trump went into an unprompted digression about immigrants eating people's pets.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普突然扯到了一段关于移民吃别人宠物的题外话。

sentences.en: I just want to clarify here.
sentences.zh: 我只想在这里澄清一下。

sentences.en: You bring up Springfield, Ohio, and ABC News did reach out to the city manager there.
sentences.zh: 你提到了俄亥俄州的斯普林菲尔德，美国广播公司新闻网确实联系了那里的城市经理。

sentences.en: He told us there have been no credible reports of specific claims of pets being harmed, injured, or abused by individuals within the immigrant community.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，没有任何可信的报告称移民社区的个人有伤害、损伤或虐待宠物的具体指控。

sentences.en: While the claims were debunked, the topic was left unexplained.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些指控被揭穿了，但这个话题却没有得到解释。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Miriam Jordan on the story behind those shocking and false claims and the town and the tragedy that gave rise to them.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事米里亚姆·约旦将讲述这些令人震惊且虚假的指控背后的故事，以及这座城镇和导致这一切的悲剧。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月13日，星期五。

sentences.en: So Miriam, one of the standout moments in the debate on Tuesday was this kind of bizarre exchange where Donald Trump made a reference to a conspiracy theory about
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，周二辩论中最引人注目的时刻之一是这种诡异的交流，当时唐纳德·特朗普提到了一种阴谋论，内容关于

sentences.en: Haitian immigrants.
sentences.zh: 海地移民。

sentences.en: He said that they had been eating people's pets in the town of Springfield, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 他说他们在俄亥俄州的斯普林菲尔德镇吃人们的宠物。

sentences.en: And a lot of people, I assume, had no idea what he was talking about.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人当时都不知道他在说什么。

sentences.en: But you knew exactly what he was referring to.
sentences.zh: 但你非常清楚他指的是什么。

sentences.en: Tell us about that.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲那个吧。

sentences.en: Well, yes, Donald Trump was talking about the latest and perhaps strangest turn in the story
sentences.zh: 好的，是的，唐纳德·特朗普谈到了这个故事最新、或许也是最奇怪的转折，

sentences.en: that I've been covering in Springfield, Ohio, a mid-sized town in the southern part of the state.
sentences.zh: 这个故事我一直在俄亥俄州南部的中型城镇斯普林菲尔德进行报道。

sentences.en: It has to do with the Haitian immigrant community in that town and the controversy surrounding their arrival in large numbers.
sentences.zh: 这与该镇的海地移民社区以及围绕他们大量涌入的争议有关。

sentences.en: And I should say right away, of course, there's absolutely no evidence that any immigrants were actually stealing and eating pets.
sentences.zh: 我必须马上说明，当然，绝对没有任何证据表明有任何移民真的在偷吃宠物。

sentences.en: This has no basis in reality.
sentences.zh: 这毫无现实依据。

sentences.en: Local authorities have denied it.
sentences.zh: 当地官方已经予以否认。

sentences.en: But it exploded on social media and this town landed in the middle of this election campaign.
sentences.zh: 但它在社交媒体上彻底爆发，这座城镇也卷入了这场选举活动的中心。

sentences.en: Okay, let's start at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们从头说起。

sentences.en: What should we know about Springfield, Ohio?
sentences.zh: 关于俄亥俄州的斯普林菲尔德，我们应该了解些什么？

sentences.en: In its heyday, it was extremely prosperous industrial barons who manufactured farming equipment,
sentences.zh: 在其全盛时期，它极其繁荣，制造农具的工业巨头们

sentences.en: built incredibly majestic Victorian homes that, you know, still line some of the avenues there.
sentences.zh: 建造了极其雄伟的维多利亚式住宅，至今仍在当地的一些街道两侧林立。

sentences.en: And generally, it was considered a mini Chicago.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，它被认为是一个迷你芝加哥。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: The city had a population at its peak of about 80,000 in the 60s, early 70s.
sentences.zh: 在60年代和70年代初的高峰期，这座城市的人口约为8万。

sentences.en: But then, like many of these towns in the Midwest, it began to lose population.
sentences.zh: 但随后，就像中西部的许多此类城镇一样，它的人口开始流失。

sentences.en: In large part because so many manufacturing jobs went overseas, companies that operated in town shuttered, and people had to look for opportunity elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是因为大量制造业工作岗位流向海外，镇上的公司倒闭，人们不得不去别处寻找机会。

sentences.en: So what begins to happen is that this town, as it falls on hard times, you begin to see houses boarded up, buildings abandoned, downtown looking in sad shape.
sentences.zh: 于是开始发生的情况是，这座城镇陷入困境，你开始看到房屋被木板封死、建筑被废弃、市中心看起来破败不堪。

sentences.en: And that decline persisted for several decades until a few years ago when the city leadership and the Chamber of Commerce decided to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 这种衰落持续了几十年，直到几年前，城市领导层和商会决定采取行动改变现状。

sentences.en: They came up with a plan to revitalize the city.
sentences.zh: 他们想出了一个重振城市的计划。

sentences.en: They started pitching the city as an attractive place to do business.
sentences.zh: 他们开始将这座城市宣传为一个适合开展业务的迷人地方。

sentences.en: The location of the city smack dab between Dayton and Columbus is a big plus.
sentences.zh: 这座城市恰好位于代顿和哥伦布之间，地理位置是一个巨大的优势。

sentences.en: It's easily accessible to two interstates.
sentences.zh: 它交通便利，毗邻两条州际公路。

sentences.en: It has several colleges and institutions for training, and it's an affordable place to live and to operate as a business.
sentences.zh: 它拥有几所学院和培训机构，并且是一个生活和经营企业的经济实惠之地。

sentences.en: And this plan actually succeeds.
sentences.zh: 这个计划实际上成功了。

sentences.en: A major turning point was in 2017 when a very large Japanese auto parts maker acquired land in a decaying part of the city and set up shop, creating hundreds of jobs.
sentences.zh: 一个重大的转折点是在2017年，一家非常大型的日本汽车零部件制造商在该市一个衰败的地区收购了土地并开办了工厂，创造了数百个就业机会。

sentences.en: And it was probably one of the biggest employers that ended up setting shop there, but it wasn't the only one.
sentences.zh: 它可能是最终在那里落户的最大的雇主之一，但并非唯一的一个。

sentences.en: You know, companies that make boxes for Happy Meals sold at McDonald's.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，还有生产麦当劳开心乐园餐盒子的公司。

sentences.en: Companies that distribute clothing across the country.
sentences.zh: 还有在全国范围内分销服装的公司。

sentences.en: But there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 但问题来了。

sentences.en: There weren't enough workers.
sentences.zh: 没有足够的工人。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 所以发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, immigrants start to arrive, in particular Haitians.
sentences.zh: 嗯，移民开始涌入，特别是海地人。

sentences.en: You know, like other immigrant groups, they hear about opportunities by word of mouth.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像其他移民群体一样，他们通过口耳相传听到机会。

sentences.en: They tell each other.
sentences.zh: 他们互相转告。

sentences.en: In this case, they were drawn by the availability of well-paying jobs.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们是被高薪工作的 availability 所吸引的。

sentences.en: And they also heard that the cost of living was pretty low in Springfield.
sentences.zh: 他们还听说斯普林菲尔德的生活成本相当低。

sentences.en: So soon, more and more Haitians arrived.
sentences.zh: 于是很快，越来越多的海地人到达了。

sentences.en: And they were very attractive to employers because they had authorization to legally work in the United States.
sentences.zh: 雇主们非常喜欢他们，因为他们拥有在美国合法工作的授权。

sentences.en: And what they have is something called temporary protected status.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有的是所谓的“临时保护身份”。

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: It's a designation given to people from countries in turmoil, like Haiti.
sentences.zh: 这是授予来自海地等动荡国家的人民的一种身份认定。

sentences.en: And it means that nationals from these places in upheaval who have already arrived in the United States can stay in the United States legally.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这些来自动荡地区、已经抵达美国的国民可以合法留在美国。

sentences.en: So the status enables the immigrants to get employment authorization, which is a huge benefit to businesses in Springfield that need workers.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种身份使移民能够获得就业授权，这对于需要工人的斯普林菲尔德企业来说是一个巨大的福利。

sentences.en: So how many Haitian immigrants end up coming?
sentences.zh: 那么到底有多少海地移民来到这里呢？

sentences.en: So estimates vary, but what I've heard from city officials is that between 12,000 and 20,000 Haitian migrants moved to Springfield in the last three to four years.
sentences.zh: 估计数字各不相同，但我从城市官员那里听到的是，在过去三到四年里，有12,000到20,000名海地移民搬到了斯普林菲尔德。

sentences.en: So a city that had a population just under 60,000 now possibly has 80,000.
sentences.zh: 所以一个原本人口不足6万的城市现在可能达到了8万。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So what happens in the town once they start to settle there and live their lives?
sentences.zh: 那么当他们在镇上安顿下来并开始生活后，情况会怎样呢？

sentences.en: How does the town change?
sentences.zh: 这座城镇是如何改变的？

sentences.en: By most accounts, Springfield benefits from this influx of Haitians.
sentences.zh: 根据大多数人的说法，斯普林菲尔德从海地人的涌入中受益。

sentences.en: They have come to work.
sentences.zh: 他们是来工作的。

sentences.en: I heard from employers like Jamie McGregor, who runs an auto parts maker, that Haitians are coming to work on time.
sentences.zh: 我从经营汽车零部件制造商的雇主杰米·麦格雷戈那里听说，海地人上班很准时。

sentences.en: They're reliable.
sentences.zh: 他们很靠谱。

sentences.en: They're drama free.
sentences.zh: 他们不惹事生非。

sentences.en: And they've now come to represent 10 percent of his workforce.
sentences.zh: 现在他们已经占到他员工总数的10%。

sentences.en: The immigrants are working in a variety of capacities.
sentences.zh: 移民们从事着各种各样的岗位。

sentences.en: Some of them are opening businesses and restaurants.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人开办了企业和餐馆。

sentences.en: They're sending their kids to schools, you know, schools that actually had been losing students because the city had been shrinking.
sentences.zh: 他们把孩子送到学校，你知道的，那些由于城市萎缩而一直在失去学生的学校。

sentences.en: And they're leasing homes and apartments.
sentences.zh: 他们在租房屋和公寓。

sentences.en: I met a landlord, in fact, who has been, you know,
sentences.zh: 事实上，我遇到了一位房东，他一直在

sentences.en: buying up some of these homes that had been delinquent on property taxes and went to auction and fixing them up to rent them to Haitians.
sentences.zh: 买下一些拖欠房产税并进入拍卖程序的房屋，然后进行修缮并租给海地人。

sentences.en: And I took a spin around town with him and I was able to see that there are many blocks where newly refurbished homes are sprucing up the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我和他一起在城里转了一圈，我看到有许多街区里，翻新一新的房屋让社区焕然一新。

sentences.en: They have manicured gardens and they look a lot more cheerful than blocks where, you know, homes are still boarded up.
sentences.zh: 它们有着修剪整齐的花园，看起来比那些房屋仍然被木板封死的街区要欢快得多。

sentences.en: So you're seeing literally a town come back to life very quickly, almost overnight.
sentences.zh: 所以你确实看到一个小镇以极快的速度、几乎一夜之间恢复了生机。

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But the sudden influx of all these people also puts a huge strain on the town's resources.
sentences.zh: 但所有人突然涌入也给该镇的资源带来了巨大的压力。

sentences.en: For example, the schools now have 1,500 out of 7,500 students who are English language learners.
sentences.zh: 例如，在7,500名学生中，现在有1,500名是英语学习者。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's meant that the school district very quickly has had to hire, you know, English as a second language instructors, interpreters,
sentences.zh: 这意味着学区不得不非常迅速地聘请，你知道的，英语作为第二语言的教师、口译员

sentences.en: and others to assist the new students and the families.
sentences.zh: 以及其他人来协助新学生和他们的家庭。

sentences.en: At the main federally subsidized health clinic in the city, the head of the clinic actually told me that they had seen Haitians lining up at 5 a.m.
sentences.zh: 在该市主要的联邦资助健康诊所，诊所负责人实际上告诉我，他们看到海地人在早上5点就开始排队

sentences.en: about three hours before the clinic actually opens to secure appointments.
sentences.zh: 大约在诊所实际开门前三个小时，以确保能挂到号。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, longtime residents could not get in.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，老居民却进不去。

sentences.en: And appointments that were scheduled for 15-minute slots can take up to 45 minutes because there's now this massive need for translation for folks who are not fluent in English.
sentences.zh: 原本安排15分钟的时段的预约现在可能需要长达45分钟，因为现在对于不流利说英语的人来说，有巨大的翻译需求。

sentences.en: And then there's the toll on housing in Springfield.
sentences.zh: 然后是斯普林菲尔德的住房压力。

sentences.en: And that problem has been exacerbated by the arrival of so many Haitians.
sentences.zh: 大量海地人的到来加剧了这一问题。

sentences.en: Rents have gone up.
sentences.zh: 房租上涨了。

sentences.en: And sometimes four or five Haitian men rent one house, they can afford to pay more than one American family with one or two breadwinners, right?
sentences.zh: 有时四五个海地男人合租一栋房子，他们付得起比一个或两个经济支柱的美国家庭更多的房租，对吧？

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So there has been some displacement of Americans who are low income and who have had trouble making their rent.
sentences.zh: 因此，一些低收入且难以支付房租的美国人开始被排挤。

sentences.en: So some resentment starts to build under the surface.
sentences.zh: 于是，潜意识里开始滋生一些怨恨。

sentences.en: But the town is just going about its business and people are living their lives until something tragic happens that makes these feelings boil over.
sentences.zh: 但小镇仍在照常运转，人们过着自己的生活，直到发生了一起悲剧，让这些情绪彻底爆发。

sentences.en: So on the first day of school last year, 52 students were on a bus that was traveling down Route 41 when a minivan veered into oncoming traffic,
sentences.zh: 所以在去年开学的第一天，有52名学生坐在一辆沿41号公路行驶的校车上，当时一辆小型面包车突然驶入对向车道，

sentences.en: hit the bus and caused it to tip over.
sentences.zh: 撞上了校车并导致其侧翻。

sentences.en: A horrifying sight.
sentences.zh: 令人毛骨悚然的景象。

sentences.en: A school bus flipped over while taking dozens of elementary students to their first day of class.
sentences.zh: 一辆校车在载着数十名小学生去上第一堂课的途中翻车了。

sentences.en: Ejecting an 11-year-old boy and killing him.
sentences.zh: 将一名11岁的小男孩甩出车外并导致其死亡。

sentences.en: One student, who court records identify as Aidan Clark, did not survive.
sentences.zh: 法院记录显示，其中一名名叫艾丹·克拉克的学生没能幸免。

sentences.en: The fact that all them little babies were just all tore up.
sentences.zh: 那些小宝贝们全都粉身碎骨的事实。

sentences.en: More than 20 students were hospitalized.
sentences.zh: 20多名学生被送往医院。

sentences.en: The driver of the minivan was a 36-year-old Haitian immigrant.
sentences.zh: 小型面包车的司机是一名36岁的海地移民。

sentences.en: The patrol tells me they arrested Hermonio Joseph late this afternoon.
sentences.zh: 巡警告诉我，他们在今天傍晚晚些时候逮捕了赫莫尼奥·约瑟夫。

sentences.en: Authorities didn't find that he had consumed alcohol or drugs.
sentences.zh: 当局没有发现他曾饮酒或吸毒。

sentences.en: And in May of this year, he was convicted of involuntary manslaughter.
sentences.zh: 今年5月，他被判过失杀人罪名成立。

sentences.en: The people, they are still here at the scene grieving what happened, but they're doing it together.
sentences.zh: 人们仍然聚集在现场为发生的事情感到悲痛，但他们是在一起面对。

sentences.en: The accident shook the community to its core, but also suddenly all the resentment that people had been feeling burst into the open.
sentences.zh: 这起事故深深地震撼了整个社区，同时也让人们积聚的怨恨瞬间爆发出来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘文娜。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写游戏《Connections》，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的一款拼图游戏。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有种叫做联觉的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我会看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So Miriam, what happens in Springfield after this incident, as the community tries to process all of this?
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，在这起事件发生后，当社区试图消化这一切时，斯普林菲尔德发生了什么？

sentences.en: So this accident really brought into the open these simmering tensions some residents had been feeling about the Haitian community.
sentences.zh: 所以这起事故确实把一些居民对海地社区一直以来暗潮汹涌的紧张情绪摆到了明面上。

sentences.en: Okay, the formal city commission meetings called the voter, called the roll.
sentences.zh: 好的，正式的市委员会会议开始点名。

sentences.en: Dr. Estop.
sentences.zh: 埃斯托普博士。

sentences.en: Here.
sentences.zh: 到。

sentences.en: Mrs. Houston.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿夫人。

sentences.en: And people began tracking these public meetings to express their frustrations.
sentences.zh: 人们开始追踪这些公开会议来表达他们的不满。

sentences.en: We'll begin with public comment.
sentences.zh: 我们将从公众评议开始。

sentences.en: We have several cards, so I'm going to ask one speaker to go to this one.
sentences.zh: 我们有好几张卡片，所以我请一位发言者到这边来。

sentences.en: And what were people saying in them, Miriam?
sentences.zh: 米里亚姆，大家在会上都说了些什么？

sentences.en: They run the gamut.
sentences.zh: 内容包罗万象。

sentences.en: I live on that end of town where a bunch of them live.
sentences.zh: 我住在镇上的那个端头，那里住着他们中的很多人。

sentences.en: And they drive down North Street the wrong way every day of the week.
sentences.zh: 他们每周每一天都在逆行开下北街。

sentences.en: We have kids that live in our neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 我们社区里住着孩子们。

sentences.en: People complained about how Haitians drive.
sentences.zh: 人们抱怨海地人的开车方式。

sentences.en: Like they're upping the rent, $1,700, $1,800 a month.
sentences.zh: 就像他们把租金抬高了一样，一个月 1,700、1,800 美元。

sentences.en: All because they have three incomes in one house.
sentences.zh: 全是因为他们一个房子里有三份收入。

sentences.en: We can't afford that here in Springfield.
sentences.zh: 我们在斯普林菲尔德负担不起这个。

sentences.en: About how Haitians are pushing up housing costs.
sentences.zh: 关于海地人是如何推高住房成本的。

sentences.en: How are they getting vetted?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么通过背景审查的？

sentences.en: They wondered out loud whether Haitians were dangerous.
sentences.zh: 他们大声猜测海地人是否危险。

sentences.en: Now we have Haitian prostitutes.
sentences.zh: 现在我们有了海地妓女。

sentences.en: What diseases do they have?
sentences.zh: 他们有什么疾病？

sentences.en: Others used racist tropes.
sentences.zh: 其他人使用了种族主义的话题。

sentences.en: Haitians will soon be the majority population in Springfield.
sentences.zh: 海地人很快将成为斯普林菲尔德的主体人口。

sentences.en: Nowhere on the planet is it acceptable for another culture to create a majority population by replacing the native population.
sentences.zh: 在地球上的任何地方，另一种文化通过取代本土人口来形成主体人口都是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Not one person had a meeting and asked anyone in this community how we felt about them coming in here and evading our city.
sentences.zh: 没有一个人开会并询问过这个社区里的任何人，我们对于他们来到这里并侵蚀我们的城市有什么感受。

sentences.en: Several people suggested that the city was being invaded.
sentences.zh: 几个人暗示这座城市正在遭到入侵。

sentences.en: You got people that are upset and they want answers.
sentences.zh: 你们有一些心烦意乱的人，他们想要答案。

sentences.en: And you know, the officials struggled to respond to them.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道，官员们很难回应他们。

sentences.en: As far as entering the country, immigrants are allowed into the country under what's called humanitarian parole.
sentences.zh: 就入境而言，移民是根据所谓的“人道主义假释”被允许进入该国的。

sentences.en: All they could say was, you know, don't blame us.
sentences.zh: 他们能说的就是，你知道，别怪我们。

sentences.en: We didn't bring the Haitians here.
sentences.zh: 我们没有把海地人带到这里。

sentences.en: They've come here.
sentences.zh: 是他们自己来的。

sentences.en: We can't do anything.
sentences.zh: 我们什么也做不了。

sentences.en: Now the decisions about who gets in this country and who doesn't and who gets to stay and for how long do not reside here.
sentences.zh: 现在，关于谁能进入这个国家、谁不能、谁能留下以及留多久的决定并不在这里做出。

sentences.en: They reside in Columbus and Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 它们是在哥伦布和华盛顿特区决定的。

sentences.en: But that didn't seem to calm people down.
sentences.zh: 但这似乎并没有让人们冷静下来。

sentences.en: I am not going to sit here at a city commission meeting in front of our commissioners, our mayor and everybody else.
sentences.zh: 我不会坐在这里，在我们的市长委员会会议上，当着我们的委员、我们的市长和其他所有人的面。

sentences.en: And all these people be told that it's not your problem.
sentences.zh: 然后对所有这些人说，这不是你们的问题。

sentences.en: Either you guys can step up and take control or get your asses out of here.
sentences.zh: 要么你们这群人站出来掌控局面，要么就给老子滚蛋。

sentences.en: So it sounds like the bus accident really opened up the floodgates,
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，那起公交车事故真的打开了闸门，

sentences.en: gave people permission to start to complain about things openly that they might have only been saying privately before.
sentences.zh: 给了人们许可，让他们开始公开抱怨那些他们以前可能只私下议论的事情。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So at this point, it's a little unclear what happened next.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，接下来发生了什么有点不清楚。

sentences.en: But by all accounts, it seems that the pressure that was building reached a point that local elected officials felt they needed to do something to address residents' concerns.
sentences.zh: 但据各方说法，不断积聚的压力似乎达到了一个临界点，使得当地民选官员觉得他们需要采取行动来解决居民的关切。

sentences.en: And so one of the things that they do is that they focus on all these complaints surrounding the housing situation.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们做的事情之一就是将焦点放在围绕住房状况的所有这些抱怨上。

sentences.en: In early July, they send a letter to the Senate Banking Committee,
sentences.zh: 在七月初，他们向参议院银行委员会发了一封信，

sentences.en: and they explain that the city of Springfield is facing a significant housing crisis that has been exacerbated by the large influx of immigrants.
sentences.zh: 他们解释说，斯普林菲尔德市正面临着一场严重的住房危机，而大量涌入的移民使这场危机雪上加霜。

sentences.en: And the letter is copied to Ohio Senator J.D.
sentences.zh: 这封信抄送给了俄亥俄州参议员 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, and he runs with it.
sentences.zh: 万斯，而他顺着这个话题发挥了。

sentences.en: There's a community called Springfield, Ohio, and it's very close to my heart because Springfield, Ohio, if any of you know the state of Ohio,
sentences.zh: 有一个社区叫俄亥俄州斯普林菲尔德，它在我心中分量很重，因为斯普林菲尔德，如果你们有谁了解俄亥俄州的话，

sentences.en: is nearly a carbon copy of Middletown, Ohio, where I grew up.
sentences.zh: 它几乎是我长大的俄亥俄州米德尔敦的翻版。

sentences.en: He attends a conservative conference in Washington, D.C., and he invokes the town.
sentences.zh: 他出席了在华盛顿特区举行的保守派会议，并提到了这个小镇。

sentences.en: Now go to Springfield, go to Clark County, Ohio, and ask the people there whether they have been enriched by 20,000 newcomers in four years.
sentences.zh: 现在去斯普林菲尔德，去俄亥俄州的克拉克县，问问那里的人，在四年里增加了 2,000 名新居民，他们是否因此而生活得更丰富。

sentences.en: Housing is through the roof.
sentences.zh: 房价高得离谱。

sentences.en: He says that middle class people who have lived there for generations can't afford a place to live, that these, quote, illegal immigrants are straining the city.
sentences.zh: 他说，在那里住了几代的中产阶级买不起住处，这些所谓的“非法移民”给这座城市造成了沉重的负担。

sentences.en: But my interest is not in protecting the good people of another country.
sentences.zh: 但我的兴趣不在于保护另一个国家的好人民。

sentences.en: I'm a senator for the state of Ohio.
sentences.zh: 我是俄亥俄州的参议员。

sentences.en: Our leaders have to protect the interests of the citizens of this country.
sentences.zh: 我们的领导人必须保护这个国家公民的利益。

sentences.en: And the next thing you know...
sentences.zh: 接下来你知道怎么着……

sentences.en: Springfield, Ohio, is facing a significant housing crisis as thousands of Haitian migrants have arrived on their doorstep because of the federal government.
sentences.zh: 俄亥俄州斯普林菲尔德正面临着一场重大的住房危机，因为数千名海地移民在联邦政府的作用下涌到了他们的家门口。

sentences.en: The Springfield city manager and mayor are on Fox and Friends.
sentences.zh: 斯普林菲尔德的城市经理和市长上了福克斯新闻的《Fox and Friends》节目。

sentences.en: Thank you for having us on this morning.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们今天早晨邀请我们。

sentences.en: You know, when we see a 25 percent increase over a three-year period, we're a community.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们看到在三年时间里激增 25% 时，我们只是一个社区。

sentences.en: We do not have the capacity to sustain that.
sentences.zh: 我们没有能力维持这种状况。

sentences.en: The mayor and the city manager say that the city is under tremendous strain because of this surge in the Haitian population.
sentences.zh: 市长和城市经理表示，由于海地人口的激增，该市正承受着巨大的压力。

sentences.en: It's taxing health care.
sentences.zh: 这给医疗保健带来了负担。

sentences.en: And as J.D.
sentences.zh: 正如 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance spoke on, it's taxing our housing.
sentences.zh: 万斯所讲的那样，它给我们的住房造成了负担。

sentences.en: And without additional federal assistance or support, again, communities like Springfield will fail.
sentences.zh: 如果没有额外的联邦援助或支持，重申一遍，像斯普林菲尔德这样的社区将会崩溃。

sentences.en: And they blame the Biden administration for letting people into the country without keeping track of them or providing additional assistance to the localities that receive them.
sentences.zh: 他们指责拜登政府在允许人们入境时没有进行追踪，也没有向接收他们的基层提供额外的援助。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for joining us this morning.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们今天早晨加入我们。

sentences.en: So what happens after this Fox and Friends appearance?
sentences.zh: 那么在这场《Fox and Friends》访谈之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: This whole situation takes a very strange turn a few weeks later.
sentences.zh: 几周后，整个情况发生了非常诡异的转变。

sentences.en: I think it's like kind of odd that like a guy like me has to come out from doing what I do on a daily basis to have fun because I see what's going on in these streets.
sentences.zh: 我觉得像我这样的人，不得不放下我每天为了开心而做的事情站出来，这有点奇怪，因为我看到了这些街道上正在发生的事。

sentences.en: It seems that it all begins with a guy at a city commission meeting who describes himself as an influencer.
sentences.zh: 这一切似乎始于市委员会会议上的一名男子，他自称为网红。

sentences.en: They're in the park grabbing up ducks by their neck and cutting their head off.
sentences.zh: 他们在公园里抓着鸭子的脖子，把它们的头割下来。

sentences.en: He claims that Haitians are grabbing ducks from the park, decapitating them and eating them.
sentences.zh: 他声称海地人正在从公园里抓鸭子，斩首并将它们吃掉。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Like, we got to do something, bro.
sentences.zh: 就像，我们得做点什么，兄弟。

sentences.en: At the same time, in a neighborhood Facebook group, someone posts that a neighbor's daughter's friend had seen a dead cat hanging from a tree at a Haitian home.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在一个社区的 Facebook 群组里，有人发帖称，一个邻居的女儿的朋友看到一只死猫挂在海地人住所的一棵树上。

sentences.en: A neighbor's daughter's friend?
sentences.zh: 邻居的女儿的朋友？

sentences.en: That's pretty far removed.
sentences.zh: 这未免传得太远了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But then there's video footage that surfaces of someone allegedly eating a cat.
sentences.zh: 但随后浮现出一段视频画面，显示有人疑似在吃猫。

sentences.en: And actually, that person was not Haitian.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那个人并不是海地人。

sentences.en: And this did not happen in Springfield.
sentences.zh: 而且这也没有在斯普林菲尔德发生。

sentences.en: But it still added fuel to the fire.
sentences.zh: 但这还是给火上浇了油。

sentences.en: And this whole situation goes viral.
sentences.zh: 整个情况彻底病毒式传开了。

sentences.en: Trump's son, Don Jr., tweets that Haitians are eating pets in Springfield.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的儿子小唐纳德发推特称，海地人在斯普林菲尔德吃宠物。

sentences.en: Elon Musk shared a post of people eating pets saying, vote for Kamala if you want this to happen to your neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克分享了一则人们吃宠物的帖子，并说如果你想让这种事发生在你的社区，就投票给卡玛拉。

sentences.en: And there's this billboard put up by the Arizona GOP that says, eat less kittens, vote Republican.
sentences.zh: 还有亚利桑那州共和党立的一块巨型广告牌，上面写着：少吃小猫，投票给共和党。

sentences.en: And then, of course, Trump talks about it from the debate stage on Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然，特朗普在周二晚上的辩论台上谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: So this is pretty wild.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很疯狂。

sentences.en: And these claims, you know, they really evoke racist stereotypes of past eras.
sentences.zh: 而这些说法，你知道，真的唤起了过去时代的种族主义刻板印象。

sentences.en: Like, it's reminding me of the Willie Horton ad, you know,
sentences.zh: 就像，这让我想起了威利·霍顿的广告，你知道的，

sentences.en: the infamous television ad from the 1988 presidential campaign that used racist fears and stereotypes about crime against Michael Dukakis, the Democrat at the time.
sentences.zh: 那是 1988 年总统大选中臭名昭著的电视广告，它利用了针对当时的民主党人迈克尔·杜卡基斯的有关犯罪的种族恐惧和刻板印象。

sentences.en: Except this is of the meme era.
sentences.zh: 只不过这是梗（meme）的时代。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In a way, this is a classic Trump campaign move.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，这是特朗普竞选团队的经典招数。

sentences.en: These memes are offensive and they turn off some voters.
sentences.zh: 这些梗具有冒犯性，会把一些选民推开。

sentences.en: But at the same time, everyone's paying attention, sharing them and talking about them.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，每个人都在关注、转发和讨论它们。

sentences.en: So they're spreading like wildfire, entering the world of culture, social media, breaking through the noise.
sentences.zh: 所以它们像野火一样蔓延，进入了文化和社交媒体的世界，突破了噪音的重围。

sentences.en: And so many more people are noticing something that at its root is an issue that's bad for Democrats, immigration.
sentences.zh: 更多的人开始注意到一个根源上对民主党不利的问题——移民。

sentences.en: So if you think about it this way, it's actually worth it for the Republicans to share this kind of stuff, even if it's gross and untrue, because it's politically beneficial.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你换个角度想，对共和党人来说，分享这种东西实际上是划算的，哪怕它恶心且不实，因为它在政治上有利可图。

sentences.en: In fact, Vance himself tweeted about this just on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 事实上，万斯本人就在周二发推特谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: He said that, yes, the memes could be false, but he also seemed to suggest that there was a utility to them.
sentences.zh: 他说，是的，这些梗可能是假的，但他也似乎暗示这些梗有其效用。

sentences.en: He said, quote, don't let the crybabies in the media dissuade you, fellow patriots.
sentences.zh: 他说，引述如下：“同胞爱国者们，不要让媒体里的爱哭鬼动摇你们。”

sentences.en: Keep the cat memes flowing.
sentences.zh: “继续让猫咪梗传播下去。”

sentences.en: So, Miriam, given all of that internet vitriol and all of these memes raining down on Springfield, it makes me wonder, what do people in Springfield think?
sentences.zh: 所以，米里雅姆，鉴于互联网上的所有这些恶毒言论以及倾泻在斯普林菲尔德的所有这些梗，这让我感到好奇，斯普林菲尔德的人们是怎么想的？

sentences.en: Have you talked to them?
sentences.zh: 你和他们交谈过吗？

sentences.en: What are they saying?
sentences.zh: 他们都在说些什么？

sentences.en: Well, in the Haitian community, they're certainly feeling afraid.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在海地社区，他们无疑感到害怕。

sentences.en: And what I heard is that people were calling the Haitian community center, asking about whether their children will be safe and whether it might be time to leave Springfield.
sentences.zh: 我听到的是，人们一直在给海地社区中心打电话，询问他们的孩子是否会安全，以及现在是否可能是离开斯普林菲尔德的时候了。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday, the day after the debate,
sentences.zh: 而在周三，也就是辩论结束后的第二天，

sentences.en: the city manager put out a video expressing dismay that these rumors and political rhetoric have become a distraction from the real problems that his city is facing.
sentences.zh: 城市经理发布了一段视频，对这些谣言和政治修辞已经转移了人们对这座城市正面临的真正问题的注意力表示沮丧。

sentences.en: So he's really trying to bring everybody back to reality.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的是在试图把每个人拉回现实。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But what will stay with me most is that just before the debate was underway on Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 但最让我铭记在心的，是在周二晚上辩论开始之前不久。

sentences.en: We felt it would be in our best interest to be here after recent comments.
sentences.zh: “在最近的评论发表之后，我们觉得在这里最符合我们的利益。”

sentences.en: The father of Aidan Clark, the 11-year-old boy killed in that bus crash, spoke at another city commission meeting.
sentences.zh: 在另一次市委员会会议上，在车祸中丧生的 11 岁男孩艾丹·克拉克的父亲发表了讲话。

sentences.en: You know, I wish that my son, Aidan Clark, was killed by a 60-year-old white man.
sentences.zh: “你知道，我希望我的儿子艾丹·克拉克是被一个 60 岁的白人撞死的。”

sentences.en: I bet you never thought anyone would ever say something so blunt.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌你从未想过会有人说出如此直白的话。

sentences.en: But if that guy killed my 11-year-old son, the incessant group of hate-spewing people would leave us alone.
sentences.zh: 但如果那个家伙杀了我 11 岁的儿子，那群喋喋不休、大肆喷粪的人就会放过我们。

sentences.en: The last thing that we need is to have the worst day of our lives violently and constantly shoved in our faces.
sentences.zh: 我们最不需要的就是把我们生命中最糟糕的一天粗暴而不断地塞到我们脸前。

sentences.en: And in an impassioned speech expressed his utter disgust, really, with politicians who he described as morally bankrupt for utilizing his child as a tool to score political points.
sentences.zh: 他在一段慷慨激昂的演讲中表达了对政客们的极度厌恶，他将这些政客描述为道德破产，因为他们把他的孩子当成捞取政治资本的工具。

sentences.en: To clear the air, my son, Aidan Clark, was not murdered.
sentences.zh: “为了澄清事实，我的儿子艾丹·克拉克并非谋杀案受害者。”

sentences.en: He was accidentally killed by an immigrant from Haiti.
sentences.zh: 他是被一名来自海地的移民意外撞死的。

sentences.en: This tragedy is felt all over this community, the state, and even the nation.
sentences.zh: 这场悲剧在整个社区、这个州乃至全国都感同身受。

sentences.en: But don't spin this towards hate.
sentences.zh: 但不要把这扭曲成仇恨。”

sentences.en: And he said that one of the worst feelings in the world that he'd had was his inability to not just protect his child, but protect his memory now that he's gone.
sentences.zh: 他说，他经历过的世上最糟糕的感觉之一，就是他不仅无法保护自己的孩子，而且在孩子离去后连他的记忆都无法保护。

sentences.en: I said to Aidan that I would try to make a difference in his honor.
sentences.zh: “我对艾丹说过，我会努力为了他的荣誉做出改变。”

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是这个。

sentences.en: Live like Aidan.
sentences.zh: 像艾丹一样活着。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.en: So here is someone who has every right to be angry and turn away from this circus,
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一个完全有理由愤怒并远离这场闹剧的人，

sentences.en: but instead he's actually walking up to a podium and speaking out and pleading for a more nuanced view of all of this.
sentences.zh: 但他实际上却走上讲台大声疾呼，恳请人们对这一切有更细致入微的看法。

sentences.en: For people to see the situation for what it is and not reduce it to a political talking point.
sentences.zh: 希望人们能看清事件的本质，而不是把它简化为一个政治谈资。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: To actually solve the probleMs.
sentences.zh: 而是去真正解决问题。

sentences.en: Miriam, thank you.
sentences.zh: 米里雅姆，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: On Thursday morning, Springfield City Hall was evacuated after a bomb threat was sent to city agencies, schools, and media outlets.
sentences.zh: 周四上午，在向市政机构、学校和媒体发送了炸弹威胁后，斯普林菲尔德市政厅被疏散。

sentences.en: Authorities investigated the locations, including with explosive detecting dogs, and determined that they were safe.
sentences.zh: 当局对这些地点进行了调查，包括出动搜爆犬，并确定它们是安全的。

sentences.en: But City Hall remained closed.
sentences.zh: 但市政厅仍然关闭。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: And that allowing Ukraine to use the weapons will mean, quote, that NATO countries are at war with Russia.
sentences.zh: 允许乌克兰使用这些武器将意味着，引述如下，“北约国家正在与俄罗斯开战”。

sentences.en: And on Thursday, the New York City Police Commissioner resigned at the request of City Hall after federal agents seized his phone last week as part of a criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 周四，在联邦特工上周作为刑事调查的一部分查扣了其手机后，纽约市警察局长应市政厅的要求辞职。

sentences.en: In a memo to the police department, Edward A.
sentences.zh: 在给警察局的一份备忘录中，爱德华·A·

sentences.en: Kaban wrote wrote that he resigned because the news reports about that investigation had, quote, created a distraction for the department.
sentences.zh: 卡班写道，他辞职是因为有关该调查的新闻报道，引述如下，“给警察局造成了干扰”。

sentences.en: The announcement came just a year after he was appointed by Mayor Eric Adams and underscores the chaos swirling around the mayor's administration,
sentences.zh: 这一宣布恰在他被埃里克·亚当斯市长任命一年后到来，并凸显了围绕市长行政机构的混乱局面，

sentences.en: which has been roiled by four federal investigations in recent months, resulting in searches and seizures targeting high ranking officials.
sentences.zh: 该机构近几个月来一直被四项联邦调查搞得焦头烂额，导致了针对高层官员的搜查和扣押。

sentences.en: Remember to catch a new episode of The Interview right here tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 记得明天准时收看《The Interview》的新一期节目。

sentences.en: This week, Lulu Garcia Navarro talks with Demi Moore about her new movie, The Substance.
sentences.zh: 本周，露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗与黛米·摩尔畅谈她的新电影《某种物质》。

sentences.en: In it, Moore plays an actress struggling with her aging body.
sentences.zh: 在片中，摩尔饰演一位正在与衰老的身体作斗争的女演员。

sentences.en: The question is, would you trade your wisdom for a tight ass?
sentences.zh: 问题是，你愿意用你的智慧换一个紧致的屁股吗？

sentences.en: And where do you land on that question?
sentences.zh: 你对这个问题有什么看法？

sentences.en: I would like to not have to choose.
sentences.zh: 我希望两者都不用选。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman, Asta Chaturvedi, and Rob Zipko.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由妮娜·费尔德曼、阿斯塔·查图维迪和罗布·齐普科制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Michael Benoit and Mark George.
sentences.zh: 本片由迈克尔·贝努瓦和马克·乔治剪辑。

sentences.en: With research help from Susan Lee.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·李提供研究协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Dan Powell and Marian Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔和玛丽安·洛扎诺的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德担任音频工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日秀》就是这样。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个受到严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称是改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我萨拉·凯尼格为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
